items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: I think Pete Yellin was doing the gig maybe at the time. I’m not sure if Pete was doing it.

ctx.x: Well you went from Woody Herman and Buddy Rich and Elvin Jones, were there any gigs that you turned down along the way?

Well I was with Woody Herman only for a short bit, I just went out to help Frank Tiberi and they just called me up as a sub. I loved it, but I wasn’t with them for a long time. Same with the Glenn Miller band. I went out for a bit to help somebody that needed to get off for a week. Yeah, I turned down Joe Henderson believe it or not, I’ll tell you why, because I was studying with Joe Henderson in New York. I was on Buddy Rich’s band. And you know Joe called me one day, I was in a hotel, the President Hotel in New…
He had a big band at the time?
